Hello Truffle Diggers or Soon To Be! 

I'm Petra, an avid truffle hunter and truffle dog trainer in the Southeast of the United States. I'm the author of "The Art of Truffle Hunting", a comprehensive, self-guided truffle dog training e-book, available on my website www.corefitcanine.com (under construction). It's more than a traditional dog training guide. It offers step-by-step guidancе, real hunt and training videos, and scientific information that will support you to develop effective hunting techniques, better understand your dog's behavior, and build the unique partnership that lies at the heart of successful truffle hunting. It's a fun activity and brings out the best in both human and dog! Feel free to reach out for consultations or in-person lessons.  

I also teach Canine Fitness (Certified Canine Strength and Conditioning Coach) and am a Certified Canine massage therapist. 
I am a Registered Veterinary Technician (RVT), and Cardiology Vet Tech Specialist (Retired/Emeritus).
